sourceText: User requested: "下一步的表格打出来看看，做完一个打✅，执行下一次吧" after B-69b8 M0 completed. In context, the next approved non-provider milestone is Multi-Model Ablation M1: freeze protocol hash, seed manifest, required Phase 1 cell matrix, and launch gate before any Phase 1 campaign.
normalizedOutcome: B-806b completes M1 by adding provider-free protocol lock, seed manifest, cell matrix, launch gate, status table, and a local checker. The checker prints PASS with assertion counts and keeps Phase 1 blocked until human approval, dated snapshots, task inventory, and budget locks exist.
acceptanceClaim: M1 is accepted only if node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m1-freeze-check.mjs passes locally, required cells ③/⑥/② are encoded with ④ optional, provider execution and outcome records remain absent, and Lattice closure does not claim Phase 1 data or readiness.
